use_when.text: Stack steps top to bottom in the order they happen, with no gap between them.
Use Done for finished steps, Current for the one step happening now, and Upcoming for the rest.
Use Event for history logs, such as Photo added or Message sent.
Turn off Show line on the last step.
Use the Subtitle for the time or a short note.

dont_use_when.text: Do not mark more than one step as Current.
Do not mix Event steps with progress steps in one timeline.
Do not use it for menus or navigation.
Do not put an Upcoming step before a Done one.
Do not recolour the marker outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Keep titles to a few words that name what happened, such as Match found.
Show times in the same format on every step, such as Today, 09:12.
